name: JoAi: Merge Contacts

description.en: Merge a duplicate contact into another. Activities, conversations, tags, and empty fields move to the contact you keep; the duplicate is deleted.
description.de: Führe einen doppelten Kontakt in einen anderen zusammen. Aktivitäten, Unterhaltungen, Tags und leere Felder wandern zum behaltenen Kontakt; das Duplikat wird gelöscht.
description.es: Merge a duplicate contact into another. Activities, conversations, tags, and empty fields move to the contact you keep; the duplicate is deleted.
description.fr: Merge a duplicate contact into another. Activities, conversations, tags, and empty fields move to the contact you keep; the duplicate is deleted.
description.ro: Merge a duplicate contact into another. Activities, conversations, tags, and empty fields move to the contact you keep; the duplicate is deleted.
description.it: Merge a duplicate contact into another. Activities, conversations, tags, and empty fields move to the contact you keep; the duplicate is deleted.

bot: Use when the user has two CRM contacts for the same person (e.g. a thin Instagram stub and a fuller contact). Pass contactId as the duplicate to absorb and intoId as the contact to keep. Prefer list contacts first to resolve both IDs. Never create a third contact.

inputs.name: Contact ID

description.en: The duplicate contact to absorb and delete
description.de: Der doppelte Kontakt, der übernommen und gelöscht wird

inputs.bot: Hash ID of the stub/duplicate contact that should disappear after the merge.

inputs.name: Into contact ID
inputs.bot: Hash ID of the richer contact that remains. Missing fields, socials, tags, activities, and rooms from the duplicate are moved here.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
